description:
Senior Technical Sales

As a Senior Technical Sales, you will work closely with multidisciplinary teams to realize high-impact engagements with clients in asset-intensive industries such as Oil & Gas, Mining, Energy, and Pulp & Paper. Your role is essential in communicating the value of our AI and advanced analytics solutions, influencing our clients' digital transformation journeys.

We are looking for a strategic and hands-on professional with solid experience in pre-sales, solution design, or software consulting who enjoys working directly with customers and translating business challenges into powerful technical solutions.

Responsibilities
  • Conduct high-impact engagements with senior technical and business stakeholders to understand strategic goals and operational pain points.
  • Present sophisticated AI and analytics-based software solutions aligned with the client’s asset management, performance and sustainability objectives.
  • Deliver compelling product demonstrations, use case walkthroughs, and value narratives for C-level and operational decision-makers.
  • Architect tailored solutions using the company’s portfolio of industrial software, balancing feasibility, scalability, and ROI.
  • Own the development of complex proposals, including technical documentation, project scope, budget estimates, and commercial models.
  • Collaborate closely with the Sales, Marketing, Client Services and Product teams to influence market positioning, go-to-market strategy, and customer success.
  • Provide market intelligence, voice-of-customer insights, and competitive analysis to inform product roadmap and business strategy.
  • Support enterprise negotiations and build long-term client relationships that generate recurring business opportunities.
Requirements
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a technical discipline; Master’s degree, MBA, or equivalent experience strongly preferred.
  • Solid experience in technical sales, solution consulting, or pre-sales within industrial software, SaaS, or analytics companies.
  • Deep understanding of asset performance management (APM), industrial data infrastructure (e.g., OSIsoft PI, SCADA, Historians), or enterprise asset management (EAM) platforms like SAP PM or Maximo.
  • Expertise in analytics, machine learning, or AI technologies applied to reliability, production optimization, or operations.
  • Proven ability to map business drivers to technical solutions and communicate value at multiple levels of an organization.
  • Skilled in developing complex proposals, business cases, and ROI models.
  • Familiarity with enterprise sales processes and long-cycle B2B negotiations.
  • Advanced/Fluent English.
Differential
  • Experience with industrial software platforms or digital transformation in asset-intensive industries.
  • Knowledge of cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP) and integration with industrial data systems.
  • Background in consulting or working in Agile, multidisciplinary teams.
  • Other languages besides English and Portuguese.

Buscamos um profissional de Desenvolvimento de Negócios, ambicioso e com foco operacional para impulsionar nossa expansão no setor de petróleo e gás no Brasil. Esta é uma função dupla: você será responsável pelo desenvolvimento de negócios para nossas soluções de EOR voltadas para clientes de energia e petróleo e gás, além de apoiar nossa equipe de Mobilidade Global com excelência operacional.

Você deve ser uma pessoa proativa e empreendedora, com profundo conhecimento do mercado de petróleo e gás do Brasil, e prospera na interseção entre vendas e execução. Você deverá saber como abrir portas, cultivar relacionamentos com a alta gerência e arregaçar as mangas para atender às necessidades dos clientes.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e executar uma estratégia de entrada no mercado para conquistar novos clientes EOR na indústria brasileira de petróleo e gás.
  • Identificar e envolver os principais tomadores de decisão (RH, CFO, jurídico, operações, C-suíte, compras, gerentes de projeto) nas empresas-alvo.
  • Construir e gerenciar um pipeline qualificado de clientes em potencial e converter leads em receita.
  • Conduzir reuniões de vendas, apresentar soluções de EOR da Agile HRO, preparar propostas e fechar negócios.
  • Fazer parceria com a equipe global de mobilidade para dar suporte aos processos de integração, documentação, visto e conformidade para novos contratados e funcionários destacados.
  • Atuar como especialista local em tendências de emprego, mão de obra e conformidade no setor energético do Brasil.
  • Apoiar projetos multifuncionais que melhorem nossa entrega operacional para os clientes.
  • Representar a Agile HRO em eventos do setor, conferências e no ecossistema de petróleo e gás.
  • Trazer ideias criativas e inteligência de mercado para nos ajudar a crescer 5x na região.

Requisitos Necessários:

  • Mais de 4 anos de experiência em vendas B2B, desenvolvimento de negócios ou gerenciamento de contas, de preferência em RH, EOR ou serviços de mobilidade global.
  • Histórico comprovado de vendas para clientes de petróleo e gás, energia ou indústria pesada no Brasil.
  • Profundo networking e conhecimento do cenário de petróleo e gás brasileiro e dos principais players.
  • Operacionalmente forte: você deve entender como passar da “Apresentação à entrega” e participar ativamente para garantir o sucesso do cliente.
  • Fluente em português e inglês.
  • Mentalidade empreendedora, com viés para ação e resultados.
  • Orientado para o crescimento, perseverante e capaz de trabalhar de forma autônoma em um ambiente de ritmo acelerado.
  • Altamente organizado, com fortes habilidades de gerenciamento de projetos e engajamento de partes interessadas.

Pontos de bônus:

  • Experiência em vistos, imigração ou operações de mobilidade global.
  • Compreensão da legislação trabalhista brasileira e conformidade de RH.
  • Ambiente de alto crescimento com oportunidades de avanço na carreira.
  • Junte-se a uma equipe global de profissionais de primeira linha que estão transformando o futuro do trabalho.
  • Cause um impacto tangível impulsionando o crescimento e a excelência operacional em um mercado crítico.

title: Financial Analyst
description:
Financial Analyst – Canonical

Join to apply for the Financial Analyst role at Canonical

Overview

As a Financial Analyst, you'll be a core member of the FP&A Team and wider finance team. You will play a key part in our monthly business reviews, quarterly forecasting, annual planning, financial modeling, and continuously drive cross-functional business alignment. Our ideal candidate is a highly analytical independent thinker, who has a desire to learn how to leverage business judgment, driven by data, to advise on critical financial, commercial and strategic decisions.

Location

This is a remote role in EMEA or Americas time zones.

Key Responsibilities
  • Generate insights into business operations by analyzing unit economics, drivers of variance, and other KPIs
  • Support quarterly and annual financial planning, forecasting, reporting, and monthly budget reviews
  • Provide analysis of commercial initiatives that have a strategic or financial impact on the business
  • Create objective analyses and processes for a fast-growing tech company to scale efficiently and make data-driven decisions
  • Support multi-functional change projects designed to enhance systems, processes, and data accuracy
  • Partner with and communicate business progress to key stakeholders against financial and strategic targets
Valued skills and experience
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities
  • Excellent presentation and communication skills
  • Curiosity and willingness to work on a wide range of projects
  • Proficiency in spreadsheets and financial modeling
  • Understanding of core accounting principles
  • Professional written and spoken English
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Passion, thoughtfulness, and self-motivation
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
  • Previous experience in an analytically focused finance or business role
Additional skills that you might also bring
  • Bachelor's degree in finance, business, or related field
  • Experience with Business Intelligence reporting, CRM and ERP systems
  • Experience with Budgeting and Planning Software, or Data Visualization tools
What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence – in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Evolved Packet Core - 5G Architect
description:
2 weeks ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider dedicated to empowering enterprises worldwide to unlock the full growth potential of mobile connectivity. With a best-in-class telecom technology platform, a comprehensive suite of globally viable regulatory licenses, and privileged access to the telecom wholesale market, 1GLOBAL is uniquely positioned to deliver seamless compliance and connectivity solutions. Serving the world's leading banks, corporations, and digital-first businesses—including neo-banks, travel companies, and payment service providers—1GLOBAL connects over 43 million devices globally.

With 2024 full-year revenue exceeding US$100 million and in line to exceed US$200 million in FY25, 1GLOBAL is a profitable business generating significant cash flows to fund its ongoing investments in infrastructure, transformation, and growth. 2024 saw major client wins and marked 1GLOBAL's evolution from a multi-market telecommunication provider to a global technology-driven mobile connectivity powerhouse.

Established in 2022 by experienced tech founders and entrepreneurs Hakan Koç and Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL is a European technology leader driving digital transformation in the global telecommunications market. It operates as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator ("MVNO") in ten countries and as a regulated telecommunications operator in an additional 31 countries. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world-class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, 1GLOBAL employs over 450 experts across 15 countries.

Position Overview

As a Network Architect, in the Network Team, you will be responsible to propose, analyze and define the requirements for new and existing services and systems, in the functional domain of Evolved Packet Core and 5G SA Core. You will be responsible for preparing, designing, testing, and delivering new solutions or enhancements to the existing product portfolio. Additionally, you will define and support the technology evolution roadmap for systems within the assigned functional area and domain, while also actively participating in and supporting cross-functional projects in collaboration with other functional areas.

Key Responsibilities
  • Collaboration with other Networks teams in defining and managing the projects for delivery of new solutions
  • Project delivery. Network design. Integration and migration strategy definition. Collaboration with other relevant departments. Responsible for end-to-end delivery
  • Iterates with the customer (internal and external) and other stakeholders to determine the technical requirements, risks, technical impacts, and recommendations
  • Design of new consumer and corporate telecom solutions
  • Creation of technical documentation (HLD's, LLD's, WO's, etc.) and maintain it over the lifecycle of the solutions
  • Understanding of End to End system testing requirements
  • Follow-up and define Quality and Performance indicators
  • Capacity and Performance Analysis, Reporting and Improvement Solution Definition
  • Service & Resource configuration definition and implementation on requested systems
  • Work on complex solutions that influence the design of current products and addresses design issues for future products or technologies
  • Market prospection of new solutions through elaboration and analysis of Request for Information/Proposal/Quotation processes and negotiation with potential suppliers
  • Elaborate, and manage the process, for change requests to current partners in order to meet the network necessities
  • Control the network elements roadmap, being responsible for the necessary software/hardware upgrade during the components lifecycle
  • Generate and implement process improvements, including and especially cross-team processes
  • Follow up of new technology trends in the Telecom industry. Documents the existing technology portfolio and proposes recommendations for improvements and/or alternatives
RequirementsMust Have
  • Proven experience on implementation of live solutions on mobile telecom (GSM, UMTS, LTE, IMS), networks design, capacity management, engineering and architecture
  • Knowledge of 3GPP, GSMA, ITU standards and specifications
  • Experience in the design, test and operation of Packet Core systems, including P-GW, RADIUS, DNS, PCRF, ePDG, DRA
  • Experience in defining, establishing and maintaining roaming interconnects for GRX/IPX
  • Understanding about IMS architecture. Experience in deploying VoLTE, VoWiFi, and QoS
  • Experience in designing, implementing, testing and troubleshooting the following interfaces: Gx, RADIUS, SGi/Gi, Gy, Bp, S6b, S2b, SWm, Sxb
  • Experience in mobile services charging (offline, online).
  • Experience in Policy control, including DPI and PCRF policy creation
  • Experience with IoT, including LTE-M and NB-IoT
  • Knowledge and experience with Diameter/SCTP networks and protocols
  • Knowledge and experience with protocols such as RADIUS, GTP-C, GTP-U, Diameter, MAP, S6a
  • Experience with protocol analyzer tools like Wireshark, Astelia, and ability to use them to troubleshoot networks errors/problems for the mentioned protocols
  • Experience with ETSI NFV architecture and solutions
  • Familiar with MVNO/MVNE/MVNA architecture(s) and landscape
  • English proficiency mandatory, other languages are a plus
  • Degree in Telecom Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience
Nice to Have
  • +8 years working on telecoms, designing and implementing mobile core networks
  • +3 years in a telecom strategy role
  • Experience in 5G Core design, implementation and operation
  • Previous experience with Nokia and Aironed Networks EPC products
Benefits
  • CLT contract — enjoy job stability and reliable benefits that value your work
  • Quarterly performance bonuses to reward your hard work and achievements
  • Meal allowance paid into Caju card —R$100 per working day
  • Health insurance with SulAmérica —50% covered by the company
  • Extended parental leave —180 days of maternity leave and 20 days of paternity leave
  • Daycare allowance provided to mothers with children under 3 years old —R$500 per month per child
  • Kickstart your journey with an exciting welcome onboarding trip to one of our European offices (Lisbon or Berlin)!
Why 1GLOBAL?
  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 100% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver's seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry

Uma Marca Fundada em Inovação, Confiança e Crescimento Sustentável

Se você é uma pessoa apaixonada por resultados, com uma visão estratégica e foco em performance, queremos que você se junte a nós para construir o futuro do marketing de busca e e-commerce.

Por que esta função é importante?

O marketing de busca é uma das pedras angulares das estratégias de marketing digital, especialmente no e-commerce. Como Estratégista de Marketing de Busca , você será responsável por desenvolver e implementar estratégias de SEM (Search Engine Marketing) que impulsionam o tráfego, aumentam a visibilidade da marca e, acima de tudo, geram conversões para nossos clientes.

Esta função é essencial porque:

  • Impulsiona a visibilidade digital e o tráfego qualificado para as marcas com as quais trabalhamos
  • Maximiza o ROI (Retorno sobre o Investimento) de campanhas de mídia paga através de otimizações contínuas

Seu trabalho terá um impacto direto no crescimento e no sucesso contínuo de nossos clientes no universo digital.

Principais Responsabilidades

Desenvolvimento e Execução de Estratégias SEM

  • Criar estratégias eficazes para campanhas de Google Ads , Bing Ads e outras plataformas de busca
  • Gerenciar a execução e otimização de campanhas de SEM, focando em aquisição de tráfego e conversões
  • Realizar pesquisa de palavras-chave , análise da concorrência e monitoramento de tendências de mercado

Otimização de Desempenho

  • Monitorar e otimizar continuamente campanhas com o objetivo de melhorar o CPC (Custo por Clique) , CTR (Taxa de Clique) e ROI (Retorno sobre o Investimento)
  • Utilizar dados de Google Analytics e outras ferramentas analíticas para avaliar o desempenho das campanhas
  • Conduzir testes A/B para aprimorar a performance das campanhas e o conteúdo dos anúncios

Análise e Relatórios

  • Preparar relatórios detalhados sobre o desempenho das campanhas e fornecer insights acionáveis aos clientes
  • Traduzir dados e métricas de desempenho em recomendações claras para ajustes nas campanhas
  • Monitorar a configuração de pixels de rastreamento , ações de conversão e outras métricas relevantes

Colaboração e Comunicação

  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com as equipes de criatividade , conteúdo e e-commerce para garantir a consistência da marca e a eficácia das campanhas
  • Manter uma comunicação aberta com os clientes, fornecendo atualizações regulares sobre o progresso das campanhas
Qualificações Necessárias
  • Experiência comprovada em marketing de busca com foco em Google Ads e Bing Ads
  • Sólido conhecimento de SEO (Search Engine Optimization) e SEM (Search Engine Marketing)
  • Experiência com Google Analytics e outras ferramentas de monitoramento de desempenho
  • Habilidade para interpretar dados e fazer ajustes para melhorar resultados de campanhas
  • Capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas campanhas simultaneamente com um alto nível de precisão e atenção aos detalhes
  • Excelente habilidade de comunicação e relacionamento com clientes
  • Trabalho remoto com autonomia e alta responsabilidade
Experiência Preferencial

(Não obrigatória, mas será um diferencial)

  • Experiência com plataformas de publicidade programática e remarketing
  • Certificações avançadas em Google Ads e Microsoft Advertising
  • Conhecimento de otimização da taxa de conversão (CRO) e criação de páginas de destino eficazes
  • Experiência no mercado de e-commerce e em campanhas digitais que geram receita
Benefícios e Cultura de Trabalho

Na WPP Media Studio , nossa cultura se baseia na confiança, transparência e no trabalho em equipe. Acreditamos que nossos colaboradores devem ter o espaço e a flexibilidade para prosperar. Oferecemos:

  • Trabalho remoto flexível : você poderá trabalhar de qualquer lugar, com horários flexíveis

We are seeking a highly-skilled Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer  to join these high-impact teams. You will collaborate closely with design, product, and engineering experts to deliver innovative, real-time solutions that elevate our partners' retail offerings.


What You’ll Do:

You will be expected to operate as a full-stack owner, driving development from the database to the user interface, with a strong commitment to quality and collaboration.

  • Practice Test-Driven Development (TDD)  and Pair Programming  as core, daily engineering functions to ensure code quality and shared ownership.
  • Contribute across the stack, developing business logic with Java/Spring Boot  on the backend and building intuitive user interfaces with React  on the frontend.
  • Design and implement scalable, event-driven solutions utilizing Kafka .
  • Participate in the entire Agile application lifecycle in collaboration with product managers, designers, and other engineers.
  • Leverage critical thinking, experimentation, data, and industry best practices to implement desired business outcomes.
  • Facilitate team ceremonies and actively give and receive feedback that is empathetic, actionable, and specific.
  • Practice emergent architecture with sane defaults and build software that is easy to use and easy to modify.
  • Lead technical initiatives not only on the team but also across the department.


Team Focus Areas:

Engineers will be assigned to collaborate on the following mission-critical teams focused on modernizing core retail functions. You will be instrumental in the following key initiatives:

Merchandising Systems Modernization
  • Merchandise Assortment Planning (MAP):  Build and extend platform interfaces to capture data in software (not spreadsheets), enabling better downstream decision-making.
  • Merchandising Financial Planning:  Focus on improving data consistency and quality across major merchandising systems.
Optimization and Allocation Systems
  • Order Optimization:  Address intersystem data issues. A key goal is to replace a vendor's size/pack optimization product (SAS) and modernize existing services to use a real-time data source (via Kafka) instead of batch processes.
  • Replenishment:  Iterate on and enhance functionality in the new homegrown ARC  system.
  • Allocations:  Iterate on and enhance functionality in the new homegrown KOALA  system.


Skills You Have:

Non-Negotiable Requirements

  • 4+ years of professional software development experience, with a focus on full-stack engineering.
  • 4+ years of experience with Java and JEE development, particularly Spring Boot, Spring MVC, and Spring Security.
  • 4+ years of mandatory experience with modern JavaScript and the React framework.
  • Direct experience using Kafka for event-driven architecture.
  • Experience with any relational database (e.g., Postgres, MySQL, Oracle) for design and implementation.
  • Proven, hands-on experience in an XP/Agile environment, including daily Test-Driven Development (TDD) and Pair Programming.
  • In-depth knowledge and experience with continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD).
  • Excellent verbal communication skills —essential for a Pair Programming environment.
  • Experience with build management tools (Gradle or Maven) and GIT.
Preferred Skills
  • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent in Computer Science or a related field.
  • Experience with large-scale application troubleshooting and performance tuning.
  • Exposure to major cloud platforms such as GCP, AWS, or Azure.
  • Experience with microservices architecture.


Essential Functions:

The requirements listed below are representative of functions you may be required to perform; however, you may be required to perform additional functions. To perform this job successfully, you must be able to perform each essential function satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions, absent undue hardship.

  • Ability to perform the accountabilities listed in the “What You’ll Do” section.
  • Ability to comply with dress code requirements.
  • Basic math and reading skills, legible handwriting, and basic computer operation.
  • Ability to maintain prompt and regular attendance and meet scheduling requirements as set by our partner.
  • Ability to learn and comply with all company policies, procedures, standards, and guidelines.
  • Ability to give direction and to receive, understand, and proactively respond to direction from leadership and other company personnel.
  • Ability to work as part of a team and interact effectively and appropriately with others.
  • Ability to maintain composure and work in a fast-paced environment while accomplishing multiple tasks within established timeframes.
  • Ability to satisfactorily complete company training programs.
  • Ability to use a personal computer for tasks such as communicating and preparing reports.
  • Ability to plan, prioritize, and monitor activities across business units.
  • Ability to complete or oversee the completion of assigned projects in a timely manner.


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to join a leading retail innovator transforming the shopping experience through cutting-edge technology.

  • 10 paid days for local holidays.

title: Process Optimization Partner
description:
About the Role


The Process Optimization Partner plays a key role in transforming the People Team’s operations through technology, automation, and intelligent systems. You’ll analyse workflows, identify inefficiencies, and design scalable solutions that enhance the employee and stakeholder experience. This role blends strategic problem-solving with hands-on implementation, leveraging AI tools, process automation, chatbot systems, and dynamic knowledge bases to optimize how the People Team operates.


Key Responsibilities

  • Evaluate, document, and improve People Team workflows across the employee lifecycle (recruiting, onboarding, development, engagement, and offboarding).
  • Identify automation opportunities using tools like Zapier, Workato, Power Automate, or internal HRIS systems.
  • Partner with HR stakeholders to reduce manual work, streamline approvals, and improve process accuracy.
  • Implement and monitor AI-driven workflows that enhance response times and reduce operational bottlenecks.
  • Design and maintain AI-powered chatbots to handle routine HR and general support inquiries, FAQs, and employee self-service needs.
  • Continuously analyse chatbot performance to improve accuracy, tone, and efficiency using feedback loops and analytics.
  • Collaborate with IT and data teams to ensure proper integration between HR systems and conversational AI platforms.
  • Build and manage a centralized HR knowledge base that supports employees, managers, and the People Team.
  • Develop structured documentation practices to ensure consistency and ease of information retrieval.
  • Implement taxonomy and tagging systems that enable quick search and smart recommendations.
  • Define and track key metrics related to process efficiency, automation adoption, and employee experience.
  • Use data and feedback to prioritize initiatives and communicate impact to leadership.
  • Stay current on emerging HR technologies, AI trends, and automation best practices.


Qualifications

  • 3–5+ years of experience in HR operations, process improvement, or business automation.
  • Strong understanding of HR workflows, systems, and employee experience design.
  • Hands-on experience with automation platforms (Zapier, Boomi, etc.) and/or AI assistants or chatbot builders (e.g. ChatGPT Enterprise, etc.)
  • Familiarity with HRIS platforms (HiBob, Workday, or similar).
  • Strong project management skills and the ability to translate strategy into execution.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with a collaborative and analytical mindset.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Hubspot CRM.
  • Exposure to AI prompt engineering, knowledge management, or digital transformation initiatives.
  • Passion for creating intuitive, efficient, and employee-friendly systems.


Success in This Role Looks Like

  • The People Team operates with greater speed, accuracy, and consistency.
  • Employees and managers can easily find answers through AI chatbots and a robust knowledge base.
  • Manual, repetitive tasks are reduced or eliminated through automation.
  • Continuous improvement becomes a core capability of the People function.

title: Especialista de Recursos Humanos (Desenvolvimento Organizacional)
description:
A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.


Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.


A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.


Missão do cargo:

Atuar como especialista em Desenvolvimento Organizacional e Business Partner, garantindo a efetividade do ciclo de gestão de pessoas e a construção de um pipeline sólido de sucessão. Ser responsável por conduzir e qualificar processos de performance, feedback e PDI, traduzindo dados em indicadores estratégicos que orientem decisões da alta liderança. Apoiar gestores e diretoria como parceiro de confiança, conectando iniciativas de desenvolvimento, diversidade e engajamento à estratégia corporativa, com maturidade, visão crítica e autonomia para sustentar a transformação cultural da organização.


Responsabilidades do cargo:


  • Conduzir e garantir o ciclo de gestão de pessoas - contratação de metas e avaliação de performance e comportamental;
  • Realizar Calibração - metodologia 9box; Assessment - avaliação comportamental;
  • Acompanhar e garantir feedback de desenvolvimento dos gestores;
  • PDI ( Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual) - acompanhamento dos resultados individual e em grupo, com mapeamento de ações e demandas de desenvolvimento e reconhecimento;
  • Mapa de Sucessão com nível de prontidão, com estruturação de agendas de retenção talentos e para as posições chaves;
  • Apoiar e conduzir localmente as ações de desenvolvimento dos programas corporativos: Mentoria, coaching executivo, ações internacionais, etc.;
  • Programas de desenvolvimento de times, como teambuilding, dinâmicas de grupos, etc.


Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Grau de instrução mínimo: Ensino Superior em Administração, Psicologia, Recursos Humanos e/ou áreas correlatas; Pós-graduação em andamento ou completo;
  • CNH B;
  • Disponibilidade para viagem;
  • Conhecimento em Excel e Powerpoint, diferencial Power BI e/ou painel de indicadores;


Desejável: Ter atuado com SAP - módulo SuccessFactors.

Informações adicionais

  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Zenklub (atendimento direcionado à saúde mental e nutricional);
  • Serviço de assistência gratuito (social, jurídico e financeiro);
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Gympass;
  • Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados.


Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta!

A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão na prática fazendo a diferença nos +892 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 39 milhões de pessoas de norte a sul do Brasil. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de centenas de cidades, levando bem estar e prosperidade.

Nossos talentos são o que a Aegea Saneamento e suas concessionárias tem de único. Somos formados por mais de 22.000 colaboradores espalhados por diversos cantos do Brasil, levando soluções de saneamento eficiente e sob medida, respeitando as peculiaridades dos locais onde estamos presentes. Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente.

title: SAP SD CONSULTANT
description:
Resumo da vaga

Principais responsabilidades

  • Colaboração técnica:
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com desenvolvedores ABAP para desenvolver e testar especificações funcionais de melhorias personalizadas (RICEFW ).
  • Gestão de projetos e mudanças:
  • Gerenciar múltiplas tarefas, apoiar as fases de implantação de projetos e se adaptar a novas leis e regulamentações tributárias.
  • Suporte:
  • Fornecer suporte durante o cutover e hypercare após o go-live.



Requisitos e qualificações

title: Senior Agile Tester
description:
Company Description:

Mojo Trek, an Inc. 5000 company, delivers an unparalleled technology recruitment experience, grounded in transparency and integrity. From midsize technology innovators to Fortune 50 powerhouse corporations, we help our clients build technology teams that make a difference. In addition to our strong presence in the Midwest and New York, we maintain an international footprint that enhances our ability to serve clients on a global scale.


We’re looking for a Senior Agile Tester who thrives in fast-moving, cross-functional environments and is passionate about ensuring quality from concept to deployment. You’ll collaborate closely with front-end developers, designers, and backend engineers to validate user experiences across responsive, content-driven applications built with modern technologies like React, Next.js, and headless CMSs.


Your mission is to advocate for quality across the entire product lifecycle — from exploratory testing and API validation to automation and continuous improvement within an agile delivery model.


Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with developers, designers, and product owners in agile ceremonies to define and validate acceptance criteria.
  • Design and execute test plans for web applications using React / Next.js, ensuring responsive behavior across devices and browsers.
  • Test CMS integrations (Contentful, Strapi, Sanity) and validate localization and marketing content workflows.
  • Verify API Gateway / BFF layer integrations, ensuring clean data aggregation and performance across multiple channels.
  • Conduct exploratory, regression, and usability testing for front-end components built with Tailwind CSS and Storybook systems.
  • Validate deployments built via Vite for performance, caching, and build integrity.
  • Collaborate with developers to identify, report, and track defects using modern issue-tracking tools (e.g., Jira).
  • Contribute to test automation frameworks and CI/CD pipelines for both UI and API test coverage.
  • Ensure accessibility, performance, and content accuracy across localized experiences.


Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in quality assurance or software testing, preferably within agile or scrum environments.
  • Strong understanding of frontend architectures (React, Next.js, or similar).
  • Experience testing RESTful APIs, CMS integrations, or decoupled web applications.
  • Proficiency with modern testing frameworks and tools (e.g., Cypress, Playwright, Postman, Jest).
  • Familiarity with design systems and component-based testing (Storybook or similar).
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills to work effectively within agile teams.
  • Detail-oriented mindset with a passion for continuous improvement and quality advocacy.


Nice to Have

  • Experience testing Drupal APIs and integrations with headless front-ends.
  • Knowledge of Vite builds, SSR, and hybrid rendering performance considerations.
  • Exposure to visual regression testing tools like Percy or Chromatic.
  • Familiarity with automated cross-browser and device testing suites.


What You’ll Get

  • Opportunity to shape quality practices in a modern, front-end–driven product ecosystem.
  • Collaboration with an innovative design and development team using cutting-edge tools.
  • Flexible work environment focused on learning, iteration, and delivering exceptional user experiences.

title: Senior Backend Engineering Analyst
description:
Sinch is a global customer engagement platform that provides communication services for businesses across messaging, voice, and email. Sinch's services are used by more than 150,000 businesses, including many of the world's largest tech companies.

Join our development team as a Senior Backend Engineering Analyst ! You will be a key player in developing modern web applications and creating surprising new products for our clients. Our team focuses on building global-scale products and managing numerous direct integrations, including Meta (Facebook) for messaging. We also integrate with various platforms using APIs, queuing, and streaming technologies.


Activities

While responsibilities vary, in a general context, here's what we expect from you daily:

  • Deliver technology projects/products aligned with the company's strategic objectives (OKRs) , collaborating with the product team to suggest and develop new functionalities.
  • Architect and develop APIs for incredible conversational experiences and integrations using modern development technologies.
  • Develop and maintain scalable backend systems for a robust, global messaging platform (e.g., WhatsApp and SMS channels).
  • Collaboratively develop and enhance distributed backend services that meet our customers' needs.
  • Actively participate in discussions about product features and technical solutions to solve customer problems and scale our solution.
  • Master integrations and communications using REST APIs .
  • Practice code versioning (Git) , with experience in Pull Requests and Code Review.
  • Work effectively in a team environment-we don't build software alone!


Requirements

  • Solid experience in a functional language, preferably Elixir.
  • Experience developing RESTful and gRPC APIs .
  • Strong knowledge of distributed system architecture, data structures, algorithms, and software design patterns .
  • Practical knowledge of Agile development methodologies .
  • Solid understanding of relational databases .
  • Experience with Unit Testing and Integration Testing .
  • English is a must. You will communicate with teams around the world daily. We expect you to have good English reading skills from the start and be willing to dedicate yourself to learning the language.


We are looking for people who:

  • Enjoy working with talented teammates to raise the technical bar for the team, seeking new solutions and bringing improvements to existing processes.
  • Adapt quickly to change.
  • Have excellent communication skills for interpersonal relationships across different teams and hierarchical levels.

In short, we seek someone willing to deep-dive into the processes, culture, people, and business of Sinch Latam, always prioritizing continuous improvement and contributing to the evolution of our products and services.


Nice to have:

  • Knowledge of other functional languages like Erlang, Go, Rust, or Clojure .
  • Knowledge of other languages like Java and Kotlin .
  • Experience with distributed systems and microservices .
  • Familiarity with container technology (e.g., Docker and Kubernetes ).
  • Experience with messaging systems (e.g., RabbitMQ, Kafka, Phoenix PubSub ).
  • Knowledge of NoSQL databases (e.g., Postgres, MySQL, Redis, MongoDB, Elastic Search, etc.).



Benefits

  • Stay healthy: We cover 100% of medical and dental plans for Sinchers and eligible dependents through Bradesco Saúde.
  • Flexible benefits: With the Caju flexible benefit card, our Sinchers can choose to use benefits on food, education, and home office assistance.
  • Family first: Our Sinchers can enjoy paid maternity leave for 180 days and paternity leave for 30 days. Plus, we provide daycare assistance for kids up to five years old.
  • Everyday wellbeing: We partner with Wellhub to help Sinchers access gyms and wellness options.
  • Secure your future : Our Partnership with Prudential life insurance provides coverage for all Sinchers in the events of unexpected absences, serious illness, accidents, and disabilities.
  • Diversity and inclusion: We offer annual reimbursements for certain expenses related to disabilities and/or transgender needs.
  • Take a break: Our Sinchers can take a day off on their birthday to celebrate with their loved ones.


Our Hiring Process

In Sinch, we are committed to following a recruitment process that is fair, objective, consistent, and non-discriminatory. Our Talent Acquisition team, together with hiring managers and the rest of the interviewing team, persistently work towards identifying the candidates that best fit each open job, based on Sinch' s hiring needs and candidates' career expectations. We encourage applications from strong candidates with relevant professional backgrounds for this role. Not all applicants will meet all job requirements exactly! Even if you do not meet all job requirements, don't let that stop you from considering Sinch for the next step in your career. We are always open to candidates that could bring new ideas and perspectives to Sinch!

  • 7+ years professional C#/.NET (Core and Framework) experience - recent in the last 2 years
  • Modern JavaScript framework experience, preferably React.js (Vue.js, OR Angular) - delivering new features, not just fixing bugs
  • Comfortable working end-to-end (UI, API, data layer, infra scripts); whatever it takes
  • Must have "ownership mindset" - you'll have the responsibility of designing, building, shipping, monitoring, and fixing the features you touch

  • Rapid learner as you're expected to ramp up on a new library or API in hours, not weeks

title: City Manager
description:
About the job


1. About us

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to revolutionize food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage!


2. Responsibilities

  • Team Building and Empowerment : Assist Keeta in establishing a food delivery sales team in new cities, starting from scratch to drive business expansion. Through systematic one-on-one or group training and empowerment models, rapidly enhance the team's capabilities and ensure the achievement of business goals.
  • System Development and Optimization : Establish and maintain smooth communication channels within and outside the team. Continuously optimize team operational mechanisms based on different stages of business development to strengthen the team’s professional expertise.
  • Cultural Integration and Team Building : Demonstrate the ability to manage multicultural teams effectively and build a high-performance team that aligns with the company's core values.
  • Goal Setting and Alignment : Combine senior leadership requirements with the team's actual situation, conduct comprehensive assessments and provide feedback, clarify work objectives, and set phased goals according to timelines.
  • Process Management and Tracking : Utilize a mature Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) framework to ensure smooth operations at the frontline. Adjust strategies promptly based on business progress to ensure process management meets requirements.
  • Outcome Achievement and Review : Ensure work objectives are achieved successfully. Conduct reviews of work processes, explore more efficient methods, summarize experiences, and accumulate valuable insights for future work.
  • Time Management and Optimization : Clearly define time management priorities for the role and different levels, and optimize personal time management based on actual circumstances.


3. Basic Requirements

  • Management Experience : Has experience in managing sales teams, with outstanding performance in another company over the past year.
  • Team Leadership Methods : Ability to clearly articulate methods for leading teams to success, with proven, replicable experience in overseas markets.
  • Experience Sharing : Actively share work experiences and provide actionable improvement suggestions to help the team quickly enhance their capabilities.
  • Strategic Thinking : Possess a holistic mindset with the ability to clearly plan business and team development pathways. When facing challenges, accurately identify root causes and coordinate between headquarters and various teams to resolve issues swiftly.
  • Focus on Talent Development : Prioritize talent growth, having previously served as a corporate trainer or established a training system within the team.
  • Motivation and Resilience : Demonstrate strong ambition and professionalism, willingness to challenge oneself, and the ability to handle work-related pressure effectively.
  • Language Proficiency : Fluent in English and Portuguese (speaking, listening, reading, and writing), with the ability to adapt to long-term overseas work and travel.


4. Job Highlights

Join us to witness the rapid growth of Meituan's global food delivery business and experience firsthand the industry transformation and growth miracles. You will collaborate with a world-class, diverse team, fostering innovative thinking, expanding your international perspective, and deepening your expertise. This is not just a job—it's an unparalleled opportunity to achieve personal growth, realize your self-worth, and drive global business innovation.

title: Engenheiros de IA
description:
Job Description

A Genesis Consulting tem oportunidade para Engenheiros de IA experientes com verdadeira paixão por crescimento profissional e entrega de valor através da tecnologia. Nossos clientes são alguns dos principais líderes mundiais em diferentes indústrias e o candidato fará parte de projetos desafiadores para construir e apoiar soluções técnicas para suas necessidades.

Duties and Responsibilities:

• Pesquisar, desenvolver e implementar metodologias avançadas de Large Language Models (LLMs) para criação de produtos de dados baseados em IA generativa.

• Desenvolver e aprimorar técnicas de Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), combinando embeddings e bancos de vetores para melhorar precisão e relevância das respostas dos modelos.

• Aplicar técnicas de segurança e governança para IA generativa, mitigando alucinações, viés e riscos éticos no uso de LLMs.

• Automatizar e monitorar o desempenho de modelos generativos em produção, utilizando frameworks de MLOps e ferramentas de observabilidade de IA.

• Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com times de engenharia, produto e negócio para transformar desafios empresariais em soluções escaláveis baseadas em IA generativa.

Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

• Experiência comprovada no desenvolvimento e aplicação de LLMs e fluxos agênticos.

• Forte domínio de Python, frameworks como LangGraph, PydanticAI, LlamaIndex, e ferramentas de MLOps para produção de modelos generativos.

• Proficiência em Vector Databases (FAISS, ChromaDB, Weaviate, Milvus, Pinecone) e pipelines de dados escaláveis.

• Conhecimento avançado em Machine Learning, Deep Learning e Fine-Tuning de modelos fundacionais.

• Experiência com deploy e monitoramento de modelos em produção, incluindo técnicas de inferência eficiente, caching e otimização.

• Familiaridade com conceitos de governança, segurança e alinhamento de modelos generativos.

Minimum Education:

  • Ensino superior completo.
  • Inglês Fluente

title: US Tax & Accounting Specialist – Foreign-Owned & Domestic Entities (100% Remote)
description:

- Single-member & multi-member LLCs (Form 1065, Schedule K-1)

  • Collaborate with U.S.-based CPAs/Enrolled Agents on complex cases while owning day-to-day execution


Qualifications

  • 3+ years of recent U.S. tax preparation experience with partnerships, S-Corps, and individuals
  • Practical experience with foreign-owned U.S. entities (Form 5472, 1120) is a strong plus
  • Solid background preparing Form 1040 for U.S. citizens/residents
  • Mastery of QuickBooks Online (QBO)
  • Advanced Excel skills and ability to build models or schedules
  • Fluency in Spanish , English , and Portuguese


You’ll Thrive Here If You Are…

  • Extremely organized and deadline-driven
  • Great at simplifying complex tax concepts across different languages
  • Curious about cross-border legal and tax structures
  • Comfortable working remotely and independently
  • Proactive – you spot problems before the IRS does


Compensation & Benefits

  • 100% remote – work from anywhere

title: Quality Control Lead
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a structured, strict, and technically-minded Head of Quality Assurance who will build and lead one of the most critical operational units in the company.

Scope of responsibility:

  • Management of a team of 30+ remote assistants
  • Quality control of 5,000+ job applications/month (scaling to 10,000+)
  • Direct reporting to the CEO


Context & Challenges

Current situation:

  • 30 assistants submit job applications on behalf of clients
  • Quality is inconsistent—there is no systematic control
  • Many manual review processes → we need automation
  • No structured onboarding for new assistants
  • No clear KPIs or performance-based motivation


What must be built:

Audit the current team

Hire additional assistants

Build a full Quality Assurance system from scratch

Automate quality checks in collaboration with engineering

Implement onboarding, training, and control processes


Key Responsibilities

Build a Quality Assurance system (30%)

First 2 weeks:

  • Audit current assistants
  • Evaluate work quality (accuracy, speed, compliance)
  • Decide who stays, who leaves
  • Create quality criteria and checklists

Ongoing:

  • Implement regular quality audits and spot-checks
  • Establish KPIs (quality, speed, customer satisfaction)
  • Track quality metrics per assistant
  • Identify repeating errors and remove root causes
  • Review difficult cases with the team

Hiring & Onboarding (25%)

Hiring:

  • Design the hiring funnel (screening → test task → interview)
  • Hire new assistants within first 1–2 months
  • Maintain a candidate pipeline (no current churn, but may appear)

Onboarding & training:

  • Build a structured onboarding program (1–2 weeks)
  • Teach systems, standards, and workflows
  • Certify assistants before they start working with clients
  • Create training materials, videos, guides

Automation & Technology (20%)

Work with engineering team:

  • Identify which checks can be automated
  • Create clear requirements and tasks for developers
  • Test and launch automation tools
  • Utilize AI and scripts for monitoring

Automation examples:

  • Automatic validation of application fields
  • Duplicate application detection
  • Performance dashboards and speed tracking
  • Quality alert system
  • Real-time monitoring tools

Team Management (15%)

  • Workload distribution among assistants
  • KPI tracking and performance reviews
  • Escalation handling and issue resolution
  • Motivation and team culture development

People development:

  • Selective 1:1s
  • Coaching low performers
  • Promote top performers into team leads
  • Create internal career paths

Continuous improvement (10%)

  • Identify bottlenecks and improve processes
  • Implement best practices and standardization
  • Maintain operations documentation
  • Work with client complaints, root cause elimination

Requirements

Must-Have:

2+ years managing operational teams

  • Experience managing 20+ employees
  • Built processes from scratch
  • Preferably BPO/outsourcing/call center/EdTech

Strong systems thinking and discipline

  • SOPs, checklists, regulations, compliance
  • Precision and attention to detail
  • Ability to make difficult decisions (terminations, corrective action)

Technical competency

  • Understanding of automation & quality monitoring
  • Ability to write clear requirements for developers
  • Experience with CRM, monitoring dashboards, etc.
  • Nice-to-have: SQL basics, API logic, scripting

Analytical approach

  • Metrics: quality %, speed, productivity, error rate
  • KPI systems and reporting
  • Data-driven decision-making

Experience in hiring & onboarding


Strong Plus:

BPO/outsourcing experience (data entry, support, back office)

Quality automation experience

Technical degree (engineering / CS / math)

Six Sigma/Lean/Kaizen knowledge

Experience scaling teams from 10 → 50+

QA/Quality Management certifications

Experience with distributed remote teams

· Perform basic troubleshooting (e.g., restarting services, re-onboarding devices, checking connectivity).

· Escalate complex security incidents and persistent issues to L3.

· Assist in preparing incident summaries and compliance reports for management.

· Ensure endpoints are running the latest security patches and EDR updates.

· Validate compliance with security baselines and recommend corrective actions.

· Collaborate with global SOC, Threat Hunting, and Incident Response teams for critical security incidents.


Required Skills & Knowledge:

· Hands-on expertise in CrowdStrike, Palo Alto XDR, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, and SentinelOne.

· Ability to analyze malware behaviors, execute incident containment strategies, and escalate threats appropriately.

· Scripting knowledge in PowerShell or Python (preferred).

· Strong analytical, documentation, and communication skills.


Work Environment & Shift Requirements:

· 24x7 support model with rotational shifts (including nights, weekends, and holidays).

· Ability to work in a fast-paced, high-pressure SOC environment.

· Excellent collaboration and coordination with global cybersecurity teams.

title: Senior Accountant
description:
Senior Accountant


Remote – Brazil


*Applications will only be considered with CVs submitted in English.


Company Overview


Sphise is a global outsourcing partner, helping international companies build and manage high-performing teams worldwide.

Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Senior Accountant to join their dynamic team.


Position Overview


As a Senior Accountant, you will play a critical role in ensuring financial accuracy and operational excellence across our international finance team. You will take ownership of complex reconciliations, advanced transaction coding, and key components of the month-end close, contributing directly to the integrity of our financial reporting.

Using your analytical mindset, technical expertise, and strong understanding of accounting principles, you will resolve discrepancies, support audits, guide junior staff, and help improve internal processes. Your ability to collaborate across departments, communicate clearly, and manage priorities will be essential as you handle AP/AR escalations, review expenses, and maintain high standards of compliance.

This position offers the opportunity to work in a structured, international environment with clear responsibilities, strong team collaboration, and room for continued professional growth.


Key Responsibilities

  • Transaction Reconciliation: Perform and review complex transaction reconciliations in QuickBooks Online; identify and resolve discrepancies independently.
  • Advanced Transaction Coding: Accurately classify and code complex transactions, including accruals, prepaids, and multi-department allocations in compliance with accounting standards.
  • Financial Reporting Support: Assist in preparing monthly financial statements and supporting schedules; contribute to month-end close processes.
  • Expense Management: Review and approve expense reports for accuracy and policy compliance; provide guidance to staff on expense procedures.
  • Accounts Payable/Receivable: Handle escalated AP/AR issues, manage aging reports, assist with collection efforts, and maintain vendor relationships.
  • Journal Entry Preparation: Prepare and post standard and adjusting journal entries; maintain supporting documentation.
  • Process Improvement: Recommend improvements to accounting procedures and help implement best practices for efficiency.
  • Audit Support: Prepare requested audit documentation and schedules; serve as a key contact for auditor inquiries.
  • Junior Staff Support: Provide guidance and answer questions from junior accounting team members as needed.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Strong proficiency in QuickBooks Online (QBO) and advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
  • Solid understanding of GAAP and accounting principles.
  • Excellent attention to detail with strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to work independently and prioritize multiple tasks effectively.
  • Strong communication skills for working with various departments and external contacts.


Preferred Experience

  • 4-6 years of progressive accounting experience.
  • Experience with month-end close processes and financial reporting.
  • Background in small-to-mid-sized business accounting environments.
  • Familiarity with expense management tools and multiple accounting software platforms.
  • Experience training or mentoring junior staff members.
  • Strong English Skills.


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Researcher
description:
Join Bentham Science Publishers as a Guest Topical Issue Editor for the journal , "Current Alzheimer Research "


If you're interested in publishing your Research, click here.



Position Overview:

We invite researchers and scientists to join us as Guest Topical Issue Editor for the journal,

"Current Alzheimer Research" , to contribute to a research area (section) most relevant to their field of expertise.


The candidates for the Guest Topical Issue Editor position should have a proven track record of scholarly publishing and organizing a Topical Issue, and they should be able to assemble a collection of high-quality research/review articles related to their section.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Developing a comprehensive proposal for a special issue, highlighting its importance and detailing prospective contributors.
  • Collaborating with possible co-editors to effectively organize the special issue and coordinate with authors, ensuring a smooth editorial process.
  • Inviting contributors from diverse regions, focusing on those with a proven publication record.
  • Promoting the special issue to enhance its visibility and impact.


*The Article Processing Charges (APC) are offered with a discount to facilitate Open Access publishing by the authors.


Qualifications and Experience:

• Ph.D. in related fields

• A valid Scopus ID.

• Prior experience in publishing guest-edited thematic issues in peer-reviewed journals.

• They must have a list of scholarly authors who can consent to contribute research / review articles in the thematic issue(s) proposed by the Topical Issue.

• Strong networks within the research community.

• Excellent communication and organizational skills.

• Familiarity with scientific publication and peer review processes.


Benefits:

• An honorarium to support thematic issue promotion and academic & research endeavors.

• Rapid publication of the special issue, with articles going online within 30 days of acceptance.

• Full APC waiver for an article authored by the Topical Issue.

• A free online subscription to all articles published in the journal during the year.


Location:

This is a remote opportunity, offering flexibility and convenience.


How To Apply:

Interested candidates are invited to submit their CVs; list of publications, and a Topical issue proposal by 25 December 2025. The proposal should include the title and scope of the Topical issue, relevant keywords, sub-topics, and preferably, the article titles, a list of potential contributors, and article submission deadlines.


Special Instructions:

• Each author/co-author is welcome to contribute one paper to the Topical Issue.

• Contributions must adhere to topics approved by the Editor-in-Chief.

• Manuscript submission extensions will be limited to 60 days.


Additional Offer:

In our ongoing efforts to expand our Editorial team, we are pleased to offer the successful Guest Editors a potential for advancement within the Editorial Board. Based on qualifications and contributions, outstanding editors may be considered for prestigious positions on our Editorial Board.


*The provision of Scopus ID is a MUST for the application to be shortlisted.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
We are still looking for talent… and we would love for you to join our team!

For over 25 years, UST has worked alongside the world’s best companies to make a real impact through business transformation. Driven by technology, inspired by people, and guided by our purpose, UST supports clients from design to implementation. Together, with more than 30,000 employees in 30 countries, we build to create limitless impact, reaching billions of lives in the process.


About the Role: we’re looking for a talented Machine Learning Engineer to join our growing AI team!


About the Role

As an ML Engineer on our team, you will design, train, fine-tune, and deploy ML/LLM models that power autonomous exception resolution, anomaly detection, and explainable insights. You’ll work hands-on with multiple LLM ecosystems like OpenAI GPT, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, and Meta LLaMA. You will implement retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, develop prompt engineering and safety techniques, and integrate memory and explainability into agentic workflows.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, train, fine-tune, and deploy ML/LLM models for production.
  • Build RAG pipelines using vector databases and frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, and MCP.
  • Develop prompt engineering, optimization, and safety techniques for agentic LLM interactions.
  • Collaborate with data engineering to maintain data pipelines for ML workloads.
  • Conduct feature engineering and embeddings generation on structured and unstructured data.
  • Implement model monitoring, drift detection, and retraining pipelines.
  • Explore emerging LLM/SLM architectures and multi-agent orchestration patterns.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with R&D, data science, product, and engineering teams.
  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to best practices in ML engineering.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, or related field.
  • 3+ years building and deploying ML systems.
  • English advance (B2)
  • Strong Python skills and experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-Learn, Hugging Face Transformers.
  • Hands-on experience with LLMs/SLMs including fine-tuning, prompt design, and inference optimization.
  • Familiarity with at least two of the following: OpenAI GPT, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Meta LLaMA.
  • Knowledge of vector databases, embeddings, and RAG pipelines.
  • Experience working with both structured and unstructured data at scale.
  • Understanding of SQL and distributed data frameworks like Spark or Ray.
  • Deep knowledge of ML lifecycle: data preparation, training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with agentic frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, AutoGen).
  • Understanding of AI safety, guardrails, and explainability.
  • Hands-on experience deploying ML/LLM solutions on AWS, GCP, or Azure.
  • Familiarity with MLOps practices including CI/CD, monitoring, and observability.
  • Background in anomaly detection, fraud/risk modeling, or behavioral analytics.
  • Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects or research publications.

Yeah, you heard that right.


Dingus & Zazzy is looking for a motivated, ambitious Graphic Designer to join our growing team!

Dingus & Zazzy is a comprehensive digital marketing agency offering services for brands looking to expand their presence across a variety of digital platforms. Our business is expanding globally, and we need talented folks on our team to continue offering stellar service to our clients.


Running a company is a little like building a plane while flying it. There’s always too much to do; doing one thing means neglecting something else. You have to blog but also be active on social media. You have to build websites and then optimize them for mobile. Email lists. Emails. Keywords. SEM. SEO. UX. UI. FML. OMG. That’s where we come in. Dependendo dos projetos, poderá trabalhar sozinho ou em parceria com os desenvolvedores do time, delegando tarefas e acompanhando o andamento dos projetos. O foco principal do trabalho será em projetos de baixa complexidade, atuando com desenvolvimento de aplicações IVA, no Veeva, programação de banners animados HTML/CSS, com o GWD e e-mails marketing

  • Colaborar com times externos para entrega de projetos de maior complexidade que podem requerer uma parceria com times globais.
  • Escrever documentos e guias de requisitos funcionais;
  • Otimizar aplicações para a máxima velocidade e escalabilidade;
  • Participar e se manter atualizado com relação aos treinamentos propostos pelo time de Operações, muitas vezes podendo ser o responsável pela aplicação dos treinamentos com o time menos experiente;
  • Manter-se atualizado com as tecnologias emergentes;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos na plataforma Veeva para o desenvolvimento e manutenção em IVAs.


Requisitos

  • Experiência comprovada como Front-End;
  • Experiência com diversas linguagens de programação: HTML 5 e Web Standards, CSS (com foco em animações e transições), Java Script, SQL, Vue.js, React, Node; - Experiência com Git, Azure, SVN ou sistemas de controle de versão similares; - Experiência com Adobe XD e Photoshop;
  • Conhecimento com ferramentas para emular dispositivos móveis e sistemas operacionais (BrowserStack, E-mail on Acid);
  • Vivência com desenvolvimento de e-mails responsivos visando à compatibilidade cross-browser/cross-platform;
  • Superior completo em Tecnologia da Informação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência com a ferramenta Google Web Designer;
  • Experiência nas plataformas: Wordpress, Strapi Veeva Vault, IQVIA, Agnitio, Tabmedia - Inglês fluente: conversação, escrita e leitura;
  • Certificação Veeva para desenvolvimento de IVAs.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência anterior da agência, particularmente de uma agência de saúde;
  • A experiência anterior como líder de uma equipe de desenvolvimento é uma vantagem.

title: Visual Designer (UX/UI)
description:

Who we are


Uitify is a brand and growth partner for early-stage SaaS companies. We help ambitious startups define their positioning, design their identity, and communicate with clarity and personality — across every touchpoint. We combine strategy, design, and content to build brands that are consistent, memorable, and conversion-driven.

We work fast, collaborate closely, and care deeply about doing work that’s both smart and beautiful.


Who we’re looking for


We’re looking for a Visual Designer who brings strong visual direction, consistency, and creativity. You’ll work closely with our branding, marketing, and product teams to design clean, modern, and conversion-focused assets for fast-growing SaaS companies.

This is a hands-on creative role — ideal for someone who thrives on bringing ideas to life and shaping the visual expression of digital-first brands.

Bonus points

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to work independently

At Uitify, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

title: Professor de francês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?



  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente
